description: An agent's proposal for a consequential state transition.

actor.description: Identifier of the proposing agent or principal.
actor.title: Actor

intent.description: Stated high-level intent behind the proposed action.
intent.title: Intent

target.description: Resource URI or target identifier (e.g. instance/i-17).
target.title: Target

evidence.description: Evidence claims supporting the proposal (e.g. health checks, telemetry).
evidence.title: Evidence

expected_effect.description: Optional structured description of the anticipated side effects.
expected_effect.title: Expected Effect

dependencies.description: Optional list of prerequisite proposal IDs or conditions.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

requested_scope.description: Optional scope or namespace requested by the actor.
requested_scope.title: Requested Scope

created_at.description: Timestamp when the proposal was generated.
created_at.title: Created At

title: Proposal
